title: Ensuring Emotional and Mental Health Wellness at Workplaces
what_it_is: Ensuring Emotional and Mental Health Wellness at Workplaces

sections.label: Workplace mental health measures
sections.summary: The Ministry released a COVID-19 worker mental well-being advisory in April and will release a Tripartite Advisory later this year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Manpower what measures the Ministry has taken in ensuring emotional and mental health wellness in workplaces.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: We released an advisory on supporting mental well-being of workers under COVID-19 work arrangements in April this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: We will be releasing a Tripartite Advisory on Workers’ Mental Well-being later this year.

sections.label: HPB mental wellness programmes
sections.summary: About 37,000 working adults have benefited from HPB's mental wellness programmes, and a tool is piloted and will be fully rolled out in 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: To date, about 37,000 working adults have benefited from HPB's mental wellness programmes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The tool is currently piloted by a group of companies and will be fully rolled out next year, that is, 2021.

sections.label: Promoting employer mental health awareness
sections.summary: MOM promotes mental health awareness among employers through an upcoming advisory, the iWorkHealth pilot, and the Workplace Safety and Health Act.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: We are promoting and taking a very promotional approach to mental health awareness amongst employers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: We are taking good steps, especially with the new advisory that we are putting out later this year to help employers understand some of the best practices out there, to put out guidelines that are agreeable between both the employers as well as the unions and the workers or the tripartite movement, putting together some of these learnings that we have had over the past few years and what works within a workplace.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: There are different work stressors at different workplaces too.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: And that is one of the reasons why we are rolling out the iWorkHealth pilot which is an assessment tool that MOM has developed with various partners to help companies understand the work stressors, for example, so that they can better understand how they can help workers cope with mental health issues and what are some of these stress points that cause mental issues at work.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: But overall, if you look at the framework today, the Workplace Safety and Health Act already requires employers to take reasonably practical measures to uphold employees' health, including their mental health.

sections.label: Counselling for work stressors
sections.summary: Upcoming guidelines could recommend counselling access and measures for employees whose root causes are work stressors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: But there are also cases, for example, where the root causes may be stressors at work and carried into work.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: This is where some of the recommendations from the upcoming guidelines could help such as providing counselling, access to counsellors, or additional measures where companies can make counselling accessible to employees or make the workplace less stressful or adapting to their challenges.
